messages:
Anya Patel: Quick sync — finalizing benchmark narrative for the launch. Need: 1) one-line claim 2) two charts (cost vs latency scatter and token composition stacked bar) 3) webinar hook + demo path 4) inbound tagging & routing. Thoughts?
Mike Chen: For the scatter: x=99th p99 latency (ms), y=cost per 1k tokens ($). Color by model family. Add confidence ellipse.
Rachel Gomez: Webinar hook = "How we cut token costs without stretching latency" — demo: live routing toggle (hosted->dedicated->private) and cost dashboard.
Owen Park: Inbound plan: add fields `deployment_interest` (hosted/dedicated/private), `latency_priority` (low/med/high), `expected_qps`. Route high latency_priority + high qps to AE for Dedicated.
Samir Kaur: Microtest A/B lines: A) "Same output, fewer dollars" B) "Production latency that scales" — run on top-funnel ads and email subject lines.
Mike Chen: Chart notes: add sample markers for 3 personas: SMB (small tokens, care about $), Marketplace (high qps), Regulated (private, latency-sensitive).
BenchBot: benchmark-run complete: 3 models profiled, median latency 85ms, p99 210ms, cost/1k= $0.52, quantized variant cost/1k= $0.28
Anya Patel: Nice. Include quantized variants as a dotted line in scatter and separate legend item.
Rachel Gomez: Slide flow idea: 1) Problem (token bills & spikes) 2) Our runtime knobs (batching, cache, quantization) 3) Demo (routing on/off, cost delta) 4) CTA (signup + proof-of-concept request)
Owen Park: For routing, create a lead tag `proof_of_concept_priority` set for any lead that requests on-prem or >10k qps.
Samir Kaur: Will set up 3 subject line variants and a short landing copy matrix. Also propose a one-paragraph blog lead that explains methodology (how we benchmark: identical prompt, throughput sweep, model variants).
Anya Patel: Assigning next: Mike to finalize charts (deadline EOD Wed), Rachel to draft webinar script + slides (Thu), Owen to update leadflow rules (Fri), Samir to spin up microtests (Thu). Anyone object?
Mike Chen: Ack
Rachel Gomez: Ack
Owen Park: Ack
Samir Kaur: Ack
Anya Patel: Great — I'll collate and run a runbook rehearsal Fri morning. :party_parrot:
